errors.text_span: и завършва с леко повишение до около 120 през 2021-2022 г.
errors.evidence: The blue line represents historical data and ends in 2021. The period "2021-2022" is incorrect as the forecast lines start in 2022. Additionally, the final value of the blue line is closer to 122, not 120.

errors.text_span: започва през 2022 г. от стойност около 120
errors.evidence: The orange line starts at a value of approximately 122-123, which is visibly above the 120 grid line. Stating the value is "около 120" (around 120) is an underestimation.

errors.text_span: Тя отчита леко покачване до връх от приблизително 125 през 2025 г.
errors.evidence: The peak of the orange line is at approximately 124, not 125. While "приблизително" (approximately) allows for some leeway, 125 is an overestimation.

errors.text_span: започва през 2022 г. от стойност около 115
errors.evidence: The grey line starts at a value of approximately 117, which is visibly higher than the 2020 dip to 115. Approximating the starting value as 115 is an underestimation.
